summary: A second window on the same library (or on the verification copy) seeing the first's changes live.

steps.does: Starts with its own actor, on the same library or the verification one.
Tells each window that the other committed.
Keeps this window's views; focus, editor sessions, gestures and GL runtimes are per window.
Prepares per requester, so two windows showing different Vs don't cancel each other.

demand: Each window's visible views and panels.

faults.when: A commit was made against a head the other window moved.

latency: A change in one window shows in the other within 250 ms of its acknowledgement (proposed).
budget.memory: Rasters and GL objects are per window unless shared through a host cache.

invariants: No window's commit is lost or silently overwritten by the other's.
A gesture in one window never blocks the other.
The desktop's close handshake runs per window.

x-friction.gap: No push exists today; two tabs overwrite one workspace.
x-friction.closes: Commits pushed to every window on the library.

x-friction.gap: The verification copy is chosen per window by URL.
x-friction.closes: Several graphs side by side, chosen per window.
